about_short_description.short_description: Engaz CRM is a solution for real estate companies.

product.name: Engaz CRM
product.description: A CRM system designed for real estate companies to manage leads, deals, and customer relationships through multiple communication channels.

product.name: Unit Management System
product.description: An integrated system within Engaz CRM for managing real estate units, including viewing unit data, images, location, and sharing details with customers.

product.name: Mobile Application
product.description: Mobile apps for Android and iOS that provide real estate teams access to CRM data, project updates, and workflow management on the go.
